text: You are loved more than you know.
He hasn't forgotten you.
Breathe. He's got this.
Your past is forgiven. Your future is secure.
God isn't finished with you yet.
Be still, and know.
You were made on purpose, for a purpose.
Fear knocked. Faith answered.
New mercies. Every morning.
When you can't trace His hand, trust His heart.
Rest is not weakness. It's trust.
The same God who parted seas is with you today.
Grace upon grace.
Light always wins.
You don't have to carry it alone.
Talk to Him. He's listening.
Joy comes in the morning.
He calls you by name.
Small steps of faith still move mountains.
Weeping may last a night. Not forever.
Your worth was settled at the cross.
Pray first. Worry never.
Strength for today. Hope for tomorrow.
He walks with you through the valley.
Love wins. Always.
God's timing is never late.
Let go. Let God lead.
Be brave. He goes before you.
Gratitude turns what we have into enough.
You are His masterpiece.
Faith over fear.
He is near to the brokenhearted.
Peace that makes no sense. That's His kind.
Every sunrise is a reminder: He is faithful.
Start again. Grace allows it.
He fights for you. You can rest.
Kindness is love in action.
Your story is part of His bigger story.
Seek Him first. The rest follows.
Thank Him for one thing right now.
When you are weak, He is strong.
Nothing can separate you from His love.
Prayer changes things. And it changes you.
The storm is loud. His voice is louder.
Hope is an anchor for the soul.
You are forgiven. Walk free.
He makes all things new.
Don't give up. Harvest is coming.
Your next step doesn't need to be big. Just faithful.
He sings over you.
Trust the One who holds tomorrow.
Be kind. Everyone is fighting a battle.
There is no fear in love.
Slow down. Listen. He speaks in whispers too.
The cross says you are worth it.
Rejoice. Again I say, rejoice.
He restores what was broken.
Walk by faith, not by sight.
You were never meant to do life alone.
He gives strength to the weary.
Lean in. He's closer than you think.
Today is a gift. Unwrap it with praise.
Mercy said no to what you deserved.
His plans for you are good.
Courage is faith that keeps walking.
Bring Him your questions. He can handle them.
He leads beside still waters.
You are chosen.
Pain is real. So is His presence.
Shine. The world needs your light.
Wisdom starts with asking Him.
Keep going. Heaven is cheering you on.
